# The Becker Team — Colorado Mortgage Broker

## About
The Becker Team is a Colorado-based mortgage brokerage led by Jamie Becker (NMLS #794730), a mortgage broker and financial strategist with 21+ years of experience and 3,500+ families served.

Jamie Becker operates through Xpert Home Lending (NMLS 2179191) and is licensed in Colorado, California, and Texas.
